esp32Http.description: ESP32 web UI and HTTP API.

captiveDns.description: Captive-portal DNS of the setup access point (UDP).

eventLog.description: TV service event log, HTTP POST JSON; only tools/server.py listens.

frame.description: UDP color frames from the TV service.

discovery.description: Discovery: the TV service broadcasts `magic` to UDP `ports.discovery`; every listener replies by unicast with `magic + replySeparator + <own IPv4>`.

magic.description: Probe payload (ASCII, no terminator) and reply prefix.

replySeparator.description: Separates the magic from the IP in the reply.

frame.description: UDP color frame: [hCount u8][vCount u8], then 2 × (hCount + vCount) RGB triplets clockwise from the top-left corner (top L→R, right T→B, bottom R→L, left B→T). No header or checksum.

headerBytes.description: hCount and vCount bytes before the samples.

maxSideCount.description: Largest hCount / vCount the ESP32 accepts.

esp32.description: ESP32 controller limits and fixed values.

maxLedsPerSide.description: Largest LED count of one screen side.

apSsid.description: Open setup access point opened without a usable Wi-Fi network.

apIp.description: Device address in setup access point mode.

calibrationPreviewMs.description: How long the calibration preview stays on the strip, ms.

identifyDurationMs.description: Approximate duration of the POST /identify blinking, ms.

httpPaths.description: ESP32 HTTP API paths. Every POST body is application/x-www-form-urlencoded and every POST replies with {"message": string}.

identify.description: POST, no body: blink the strip white, then restore; not saved.

restart.description: POST, no body: reply, then restart.

cors.description: CORS headers of the ESP32 HTTP API: every response has Access-Control-Allow-Origin; OPTIONS on any path answers `preflightStatus` with the allow headers.

preflightStatus.description: HTTP status of the OPTIONS reply.

messagePort.description: Tizen MessagePort IPC between the TV UI and the TV service (local to the TV). Messages are bundles of string key/values.

servicePort.description: Local port the service listens on.

uiPort.description: Local port the UI listens on and passes as the reply port.

idKey.description: Optional request id of a `command` request, echoed in its reply.

statusKey.description: Reply value with the ServiceStatus JSON.

resultKey.description: Reply value with the ServiceCommandResult JSON.

tvApp.description: Tizen application IDs of the TV package.
